_readme: Dated exceptions for the ECR image-scan gate (scripts/security-gate.py ecr).
An entry lets ONE named CVE through, for a fixed number of days, and every
use is printed in the build log with its owner and expiry. It exists because
a base-image CRITICAL with no `fixed_in_version` can never be fixed inside
this build, and a gate that can never pass gets deleted — which protects
nothing. Adding an entry is a risk acceptance: it is reviewed in a pull
request, it names an owner, and it lapses on its own.
Any CRITICAL finding without an entry still fails the build, and an expired
entry is a failure, not a warning. Keep this list as short as possible and
the expiry as close as possible.
